cohort: The study recruited 50 pregnant women with Rheumatoid Arthritis and 200 healthy pregnant controls.
finding: Pregnant women with RA had significantly higher rates of preterm labor, NICU admission, and low birth weight compared to healthy controls, with longer disease duration, high ESR/CRP, and higher DAS28-CRP further increasing the risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes including NICU admission and stillbirth.
mod_finding: No significant difference was observed in the rate of cesarean section between pregnant RA patients and healthy controls.
